requirements.text: Every distinct exposure that intersects the selection is re-timed to N frames ("on ones / twos / threes"); the following cells of the element shift to close or open the gap so that the sequence of drawings is preserved. requirements.text: Computation — let D be the drawings from first to last in drawing-bank order (reversed when last precedes first), n = |D|, e = expose-each, l = expose-last:
requirements.basis: Model/handler inspection, builder c31 suites, independent c31_r1_mutations common-contract matrix and candidate CI.

requirements.text: - None: frames = (n − 1)·e + l.
requirements.basis: Model/handler inspection, builder c31 suites, independent c31_r1_mutations common-contract matrix and candidate CI.

requirements.text: - Continuous, k loops: D repeated k times; every drawing is exposed e frames except the final drawing of the whole cycle, which uses l; frames = (k·n − 1)·e + l.
requirements.basis: Model/handler inspection, builder c31 suites, independent c31_r1_mutations common-contract matrix and candidate CI.

requirements.text: - Forward-backward, k loops: each loop is D followed by reverse(D) without its first and last elements (2n − 2 drawings); frames = (k·(2n − 2) − 1)·e + l.
requirements.basis: Model/handler inspection, builder c31 suites, independent c31_r1_mutations common-contract matrix and candidate CI.

requirements.text: - When first = last (n = 1), the cycle is a single drawing; forward-backward behaves as continuous.

requirements.text: - When the user edits total frames, loops = ceil(frames ÷ frames-per-loop) and the last loop is truncated to the requested frame count.

requirements.text: 2. **Explicit targets.** Every cell command accepts an explicit target — `elementIds` / `elementId` plus `from`/`to` (or `frame`). When the target is omitted, the shared selection and current position are used (the selection-based variant used by the GUI). A command called with an explicit target MUST NOT change the UI selection or the current frame. If neither a target nor a usable selection exists the command fails with `cell.noTarget`.
requirements.basis: Model/handler inspection, builder c31 suites, independent c31_r1_mutations common-contract matrix and candidate CI.

requirements.text: 3. **Addressing.** Elements are addressed by stable `id` or by path (`scene:"Intro"/element:"Bob"`); drawings by `id`, by path (`scene:"Intro"/element:"Bob"/drawing:"3"`), or — where a parameter is a drawing *name* (`drawing`, `firstDrawing`) — by name within the target element. Frames are 1-based integers; there are no spatial coordinates in this area (scene-space positions of elements belong to 05).
requirements.basis: Model/handler inspection, builder c31 suites, independent c31_r1_mutations common-contract matrix and candidate CI.

requirements.text: 4. **Dialogs become parameters.** Batch creation → `element.create {type, name, count}`; rename → `element.rename`; set exposure N → `cell.exposure.set {length}`; extend exposure → `cell.fill.apply {toFrame}`; insert cells → `cell.range.add`; create cycle → `cell.cycle.create {cycles}`; advanced cycle → `cell.columnate.apply`; change start frame / duration / loops → `element.timing.set`; set current frame / playback start / end → `timeline.currentFrame.set`, `timeline.playbackRange.set`; notes → `element.note.set`, `cell.note.set`; colour pickers → `colour` parameters; transfer-option dialogs → `timeline.transferOptions.set` or an inline `options` object.
